text:
emily: Quick sync from today's runtime roadmap bit. Need three short clarifications we can paste into the notes: 1) sprint timing for sparse-attn vs quant kernels, 2) default KV cache eviction on Hosted, 3) recommended "safe" batching defaults for Hosted vs Dedicated (batch_ms, max_batch_tokens, prewarm). Please keep replies short. @sam @raj
sam: Sparse-attn currently in-sprint but behind a gating CI test; aiming for canary next week. Quant kernels start next sprint (planning this week). Hosted KV eviction default = LRU (tenants can opt into TTL).
raj: Hosted defaults: batch_ms=12, max_batch_tokens=4096 (good p95/p99 balance for chat). Dedicated w/ prewarm: batch_ms=25, max_batch_tokens=8192. Note: sparse-attn helps >6k contexts; we're prioritizing quant for 2k-4k models per telemetry.
kevin: Ops note: p99 spikes still come from cold-starts and oversized requests. I added a `cold_start` trace attribute so SRE can filter. Playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/kernel-release (see rollback/canary).
lisa: I'll produce a tiny CSV with p50/p95/p99 + cost delta for batch_ms buckets (5/12/20/25). ETA Wed morning.
maria: PM ask: include a cost-delta column (even rough %) so sales can discuss tradeoffs.
dina: Filing DOC ticket DOC-9001 to publish defaults + copy-ready config snippet for docs.
sam: Copy-ready snippet for docs (feel free to paste):
```
runtime_defaults:
  batching:
    batch_ms: 12
    max_batch_tokens: 4096
    adaptive: true  # runtime may lower batch_ms under tail-latency pressure
  kv_cache:
    policy: LRU
    ttl_seconds: 0  # tenant override >0 enables TTL-first eviction
  prewarm:
    enabled: false
    window_ms: 1000
```
emily: Good. Can someone post a 2-line summary for the all-hands notes with owners + ETA? One sentence per item.
sam: I'll post: "Sparse-attn: in-sprint (gate pending) -> canary next week; Quantized kernels: sprint+1 planning; KV default: LRU; Batching defaults: Hosted batch_ms=12/max_tokens=4096, Dedicated w/prewarm batch_ms=25/max_tokens=8192. Owners: Sam/Raj/Lisa. ETA: Sam EOD, Lisa Wed."
lisa: Confirmed — CSV draft to DOC-9001 by Wed COB.
raj: I'll follow up with Dedicated pool sizing guidance after Lisa's CSV (ETA Thu).
kevin: CI perf tests will gate canary; I'll ensure they're green pre-rollout.
deploy-bot: deploy-notify: planned canary rollout kernel-v11 on 2026-03-29T02:00:00Z (2h window).
emily: Thanks all — I'll paste the two-line summary into #all-hands-notes once Sam posts it. If you want to opt out of follow-ups, say so here.
maria: staying on for PM follow-ups.
dina: noted as doc owner.
sam: Posting kernel RFC link in follow-up.
